findings.message: OptionListColorVolume uses display.stateRole='empty' without a display.when binding, so the empty state is hardcoded rather than gated on the actual selection state implied by the return-from-auth scenario.
findings.suggestion: Either remove the stateRole and let the populated/empty variant be data-driven, or pair stateRole='empty' with display.when bound to a selection emptiness flag from FN-PRDD-OPTION-001.

findings.message: area.2 (validation feedback) carries display.stateRole='error' but no display.when, so the '담기 조건 확인' Callout renders unconditionally. SourceSpec errorPolicy='영역 전체 숨김' for area 2 requires mutually exclusive gating.
findings.suggestion: Bind area.2.display.when to a validation-result flag (e.g., FN-PRDD-COMBO-001 restriction signal) so the area collapses when no restriction exists.

findings.message: OptionList contract exposes 'items' (role=data, array) and 'selectedId' (role=state) but the candidate only sets title and columns. Without an items binding, the re-selection surface cannot actually render color/volume/contract choices from FN-PRDD-OPTION-001.
findings.suggestion: Add props.items as a propBinding to the option dataset and propagate selectedId/state per the OptionList contract.

findings.message: ListSelected catalog entry includes 'checked' (state) and 'showPrice'/'showButton' (visibility); the candidate only sets label and type, so the selection state of the benefit and group-product rows is not represented.
findings.suggestion: Bind props.checked to selectedBenefit / selectedGroupProduct state so re-selection truly reflects user state.

findings.message: ScreenIntent.missingDecisions and PI-PRDD-COMBO-001-04 imply ActionButtonNext should disable when 담기 판정이 false. Candidate hardcodes variant='primary' with no disabled/when gating.
findings.suggestion: Add a display.when or disabled prop bound to the combo-validation pass flag so the CTA reflects the eligibility policy.

findings.message: area.1 sets divider=true (1px contents) and sectionDivider=true (4px trailing). This correctly separates form area from feedback area per LAYOUT_SPACING_CONTRACT; area.2 correctly omits sectionDivider as the last contents area.
findings.suggestion: No change required; confirm renderer applies sectionDivider only when the next sibling area is visible (i.e., not when area.2 is hidden by errorPolicy).
